svg.title: Certificado Trusted Quality 2026-2027

g.text: The aforesaid implant complies with the CleanImplant Quality Mark Criteria according to
the CleanImplant Guideline (revised 2025) and consensus recommendation of the Scientific Advisory Board.
Reprodução informativa do certificado emitido pela CleanImplant Foundation. O documento original, assinado, está disponível mediante pedido.

svg.text: Dr. Amit Patel BDS MSc MClinDent FDS RCSEd
